_about: The ontology's identity: its release rises on every published change, `extends` names what it composes on top of, `carries` what the directory holds.
name: ddd
summary: Domain-Driven Design of a product's solution: subdomains, bounded contexts and their map, use cases, events, commands, reactions, read models, external systems, aggregates, entities, value objects, business rules, domain services; what each satisfies, who owns it, and whether the builder may build it.

changelog.note: Generalised out of ddd-kyc @2 (decided with Chiheb Dkhil, 2026-10-07): sits on software-architecture and product, so the product's personas, roles, requirements, scenarios, policies, terms, decisions and open questions serve and the estate's team and component carry a context. The event-storming policy is Reaction. 24 questions, a sample on the payments platform.
